details:
Description

Friend locations, group instances, friend statuses, uploaded emojis and very likely alot more things stop refreshing. The game shows that my friend is in instance with 0 people in there and on blue status but on vrcx or the website theyre on orange. Its like the game stops communicating with api. The game stops receiving invites, invite requests, boops aswell.

Reproduction Steps

I dont know what causes this to happen other than having the game open for over an hour (around an hour is the lowest amount of time ive noticed it happen). Restarting the game fixes it until this bug occurs again

Details

- Category: Networking

- Frequency: Often
